title: VSN 剧情场景脚本（结局与平行版本）（第 4／5 部分）

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It is the age of faster than light travel and advanced cyber-robotics.
rows.current: auto(8.0): 这是超光速航行与先进赛博机器人技术的时代。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [THE 3P ORGANIZATION] has become a driving force for space exploration.
rows.current: auto(8.0): [3P组织]已成为推动太空探索的一股重要力量。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Brave heroes are sent out by [THE 3P ORGANIZATION] to gather information.
rows.current: auto(8.0): [3P组织]派出英勇之士，前往各地收集情报。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: These [COSMOBREEDERS], as they are known, allow civilization to prosper.
rows.current: auto(8.0): 这些被称为[宇宙育种者]的英雄，让文明得以繁荣。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Traveling through the stars and making new discoveries is a life of adventure.
rows.current: auto(8.0): 穿行群星，探寻未知，这就是冒险的人生。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Respected by all, many a child dreams of growing up to become a [COSMOBREEDER]
rows.current: auto(8.0): 人人敬仰，许多孩子梦想长大后成为[宇宙育种者]。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Space travel and leaving the safety of home is not for the faint of heart, however.
rows.current: auto(8.0): 然而，离开安稳的家园、踏上星际旅途，绝非胆小者所能为。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: For who can truly say what dangers await on distant, unknown planets...
rows.current: auto(8.0): 毕竟，谁又能说清遥远的未知星球上潜藏着什么危险……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...I can see...!
rows.current: text: ……我看见了……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: We, the Fenfen, have lived for eons on this planet that you know as "Tutone".
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们Fenfen，在这颗你们称为「图托恩」的星球上，已经生活了无数纪元。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Having eschewed the sort of technological advances that your culture thrives on
rows.current: lang(Fox): 摒弃了你们的文化赖以繁荣的那类技术进步之后，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: we have lived simple, satisfying lives in harmony with the planet itself.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们与这颗星球和谐共生，过着简单而满足的生活。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Quiet and modest are the best ways to describe us Fenfen.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 安静谦逊，最适合形容我们Fenfen。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: All major quarrels were sorted out by a council of the wisest ESPers we had.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 所有重大纷争，都由我们中最睿智的超能力者所组成的理事会来化解。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: With our highly attuned senses and powers, we were able to find solutions that
rows.current: lang(Fox): 凭借我们高度敏锐的感官与力量，我们总能找到解决之道，这些方案

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: benefitted all of society at once.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 能让整个社会同时受益。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: However, even with our attunement...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 然而，即便有着这份感应力……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...we were not able to sense that amongst us ESPers lay one whose ambitions
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……我们竟未察觉，超能力者之中藏着一人，其野心

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: would throw the very planet itself into chaos...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 会将整颗星球本身都拖入混沌……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...her name was Traeh.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……她的名字是Traeh。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Gifted beyond her years, with an uncanny ability to find solutions others missed
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她年纪虽轻，却天赋出众，总能找到别人想不到的办法。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: the ESPer Traeh seemed like a fine addition to the council.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 超能力者Traeh看来很适合加入议会。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: She was readily granted access to the stores of power that we Fenfen kept.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她顺利获准接触我们Fenfen储存的力量。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Power... that she then proceeded to corrupt.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 力量……而她随即着手将其腐化。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Absorbing ancient caches of ESPer power that were left by previous generations
rows.current: lang(Fox): 吸收了前代遗留下来的古老超能力者力量贮藏之后，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Traeh was left deeply disfigured, down to her very core.
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh从外貌到内心，都已扭曲得面目全非。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Maybe if we, the remaining elder ESPers of the council, reacted faster
rows.current: lang(Fox): 也许我们议会中剩下的超能力者长老若能更快应对

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: then we could've prevented the calamity that was about to befall our people.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 就本可以阻止那场即将降临到我们族人头上的灾难。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Alas, we did not, and that will forever be our greatest failing...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 可惜，我们没有，而这将永远是我们最大的过错……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now go, destined hero.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 去吧，命中注定的英雄。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Free my brothers and sisters and restore peace to the land!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 解放我的兄弟姐妹，让这片土地重归和平！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: As dark forces descended on all Fenfen, young and old alike,
rows.current: lang(Fox): 当黑暗势力降临到全体Fenfen——无论老幼——头上时，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: it truly did seem like all hope was lost.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 一切希望看起来当真都已破灭。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Powerful though the ESPers of our people may have been, violence was unknown to us.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们族中的超能力者虽然强大，却从未接触过暴力。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Only when pushed to the end of options, when even surrender seemed impossible
rows.current: lang(Fox): 只有当被逼至绝路，连投降似乎都变得不可能时，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: did the first of us strike out...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们中才有人第一个出手反抗……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...and retaliate!
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……并予以还击！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Psychic abilities once turned only towards a common good
rows.current: lang(Fox): 曾经只用于共同福祉的心灵能力，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: would now be turned against those who would try to subjugate us Fenfen!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 如今要对准那些企图征服我们Fenfen的人！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: An arsenal of ESPer abilities became harnessed as weapons of war.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 超能力者的种种本领，都化作了战争武器。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Explosive psychic projectiles blasted away foes.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 爆裂的灵能弹将敌人轰退。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Punishing waves of telekinetic force prevented advancement of armies.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 强劲的念动力波阻住了大军前进。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Some even went so far as to transform their very bodies into tools for combat.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 有些人甚至改变自己的身体，把它化作战斗的工具。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Ancient beings heard the cries of mental anguish that rang throughout the planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): 古老的存在们听见了回荡于整颗星球的精神痛呼，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Some, like the noble Elves, took up ancient weapons in order to aid us Fenfen...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 其中一些，比如高贵的精灵，拿起了古老的武器来援助我们Fenfen……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...while other ancient beings, from deep within the bowels of the planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……而其他古老的存在，则从这颗星球最深的地底，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: awoke with a desire for vengeance and domination of their own...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 带着属于它们自己的复仇与征服欲望苏醒了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The great war waged for years between the evil forces of Traeh
rows.current: lang(Fox): 这场大战持续多年，交战双方是Traeh的邪恶势力

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and the formerly peaceful Fenfen that inhabited this land.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 与曾经和平、居住在这片土地上的Fenfen。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It seemed to all that this war might go on forever, with no decisive victories.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 在所有人看来，这场战争或许会永远打下去，谁也无法取得决定性胜利。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Without a vital member of the Fenfen council representing a vital force
rows.current: lang(Fox): 议会失去了一位代表重要力量的 Fenfen 核心成员，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: the remaining councilors were hamstrung.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 余下的议员便处处受制。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The psychic bonds between the members still held, requiring constant vigilance
rows.current: lang(Fox): 成员之间的灵能联结依然维系着，只是需要时刻保持警觉，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: to keep dark forces from consuming more ESPers.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 以免黑暗力量吞噬更多超能力者。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but then, one day, an opportunity arose...
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……可是有一天，一个机会出现了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: A moment of psychic weakness left Traeh disarmed and distracted for but a moment
rows.current: lang(Fox): 心灵上的一时虚弱，让Traeh卸下防备、分了神，哪怕只有一瞬，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and in that moment the remaining members of the council struck!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 就在那一刻，其余议员出手了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Unable to overcome the psychic disturbance and deal a final blow,
rows.current: lang(Fox): 无法克服这股灵能扰动、给出致命一击，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: the councilors instead froze Traeh in a crystal prison.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 议员们转而将Traeh封冻在一座水晶囚牢之中。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: With no fierce leader to guide them, the oppor- tunistic hordes broke apart
rows.current: lang(Fox): 没有了凶悍首领的指引，那群见风转舵的乌合之众土崩瓦解，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: fleeing from the powers of the Fenfen council.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 在Fenfen议会的威势下四散逃窜。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: This is not to say that it was a triumphant moment for the Fenfen...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 不过，这可算不上Fenfen的凯旋时刻……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Indeed, heavy prices were paid on both sides of the conflict.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 事实上，冲突的双方都付出了惨重的代价。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The planet you landed on is no longer the peaceful home of the Fenfen
rows.current: lang(Fox): 你所登陆的这颗星球，已不再是Fenfen那宁静的家园，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but merely a chaotic shadow of its former self.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 而只是往日模样的一个混沌残影。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Many Fenfen as of yet are held captive by remnants of the would-be conquerors
rows.current: lang(Fox): 至今仍有许多Fenfen被那些妄图征服者的残部俘虏着，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: awaiting the day that a hero will free them...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 等待着有朝一日，一位英雄前来解救他们……

rows.source: Whew! That was a pretty decent work out!
rows.current: text: 呼！这运动量还真够劲！

rows.source: Guess you were expecting a lesser agent again, huh?
rows.current: text: 看来你以为这次又是个不入流的特工，嗯？

rows.source: If you're not willing to negotiate, I *am* prepared to defend myself.
rows.current: text: 要是你不肯谈，我*也*已经做好自卫的准备了。

rows.source: But first, looks like you've got some stolen cosmo-gear...
rows.current: text: 不过先等等，看来你这里有偷来的宇宙装备……

rows.source: Lookee what we have here... my lighttazer!
rows.current: text: 瞧瞧，这是什么……我的光刃电击器！

rows.source: Those darn little twerps must've squirrelled it away here.
rows.current: text: 肯定是那几个讨厌的小混蛋把它藏在这儿了。

rows.source: Hey, waitasec... This isn't mine! This looks like one that...
rows.current: text: 哎，等等……这不是我的！看着像是……

rows.source: ...some dumb little newbie would've dropped!
rows.current: text: ……某个蠢新手才会弄丢的东西！

rows.source: Man oh man, I'd hate to be the trainee that dropped their first Lighttazer!
rows.current: text: 天哪，弄丢第一把光电击枪的实习生可惨了！

rows.source: That's the kinda thing that gets you dragged in front of HR!
rows.current: text: 这种事可是会被人事部叫去训话的！

rows.source: Thankfully, I'm far too elite to ever do something like that!
rows.current: text: 幸好我这种精英，绝不会干那种事！

rows.source: I just, uhh...
rows.current: text: 我只是，呃……

rows.source: ...left mine back at the ship? I think?
rows.current: text: ……把我的落在船上了？大概吧？

rows.source: Anyways! No time to be concerned about such minor details.
rows.current: text: 总之！没空纠结这些小细节了。

rows.source: Tutone's got an eco-crisis to resolve, and I've got a little bro to find!
rows.current: text: 图托恩的生态危机等着解决，我还得找到弟弟！

rows.source: Well well, looks like you're awake.
rows.current: text: 哟，看来你醒了。

rows.source: I'm not here to hurt you, big guy. I just want a little information.
rows.current: text: 我不是来伤害你的，大块头。我只是想打听点消息。

rows.source: First things first, have you seen any other cosmo-agents down in this-
rows.current: text: 先说正事，你有没有在这下面见过其他宇宙特工——

rows.source: Eeeek!!
rows.current: text: 呀啊！！

rows.source: Heeey! What are you freaking out about? I just wanted to talk!
rows.current: text: 喂——！你慌什么？我只是想聊聊！

rows.source: Gah!! You get back here! I'm not done with you yet!
rows.current: text: 啊！！给我回来！我还没跟你说完呢！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Hmf, getting a bit tired of this planet, and all you immortal beings on it...
rows.current: text: 哼，有点受够这颗星球，还有你们这些住在上面的不朽生灵了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: No matter how many hits you take, you're still fresh as when I walked in here!
rows.current: text: 不管挨了多少下，你还是跟我刚进来时一样精神！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Lemme guess, you're one of those immortal elves?
rows.current: text: 让我猜猜，你也是那些不朽精灵中的一员？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Correct, young lady. I am Enelye, the Immortal High Lady of the Tutone Elves.
rows.current: text: 没错，年轻的女士。我是恩莉耶，图托恩精灵的不朽至高女领主。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I must commend your most respectable performance in the art of combat
rows.current: text: 你在战斗技艺上的表现令人肃然起敬，我必须予以赞扬。即便对我这样年长的人而言，观赏这场表演也十分愉快。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: it was a highly enjoyable act to watch, even for one as old as I.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was so enjoyable, that I believe you are due for a reward.
rows.current: text: 实在是太令人愉快了，我想你理应得到一份奖励。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: So please, sit back and relax while I...
rows.current: text: 所以，请坐好，放松下来，让我……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...reward... you suitably...
rows.current: text: ……好好地……奖励你……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Woah! W-wait a minute, L-lady Enelye...! I'm here to *save* your-
rows.current: text: 哇！等、等一下，女、女领主恩莉耶……！我是来*拯救*你的——

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Eeeek!
rows.current: text: 呀啊！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...really!? I can do this myself!
rows.current: text: ……不是吧！？我自己能来！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Wa-hey! Actually, I'm usually not a dress-girl... but this feels really nice!
rows.current: text: 哇哦！其实我平时不怎么穿裙子……不过这感觉真不错！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but next time, your highness?
rows.current: text: ……不过下次，殿下？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I'll dress myself!
rows.current: text: 我自己穿衣服！

rows.current: text: 哼，有点受够这颗星球，还有你们这些住在上面的不朽生灵了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Thou hast fought a fair round for such an untrained hand.
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 汝虽未受操练，这一战倒也打得不赖。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Pray, tell me thine name so that I may honor thee.
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 敢问阁下尊姓大名，好让吾致以敬意。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...ahh, but the people of thy land do not speaketh my tongue...
rows.current: lang(HardFox): ……啊，然汝故土之人不通吾语……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: What gives?! All the punishment I'm dishing out...
rows.current: text: 搞什么？！我下了这么多狠手……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...only seems to make you stronger?! What ARE you?!
rows.current: text: ……反倒只让你越来越强？！你到底是什么东西？！
